Finished in Classic Silver Metallic over a Black SofTex-trimmed interior, this 2019 Toyota Corolla XSE brings together the long-standing reputation of Toyota practicality with a noticeably sharper edge in both styling and driving character. While many compact sedans focus purely on economy, the XSE trim elevates the Corolla into something far more premium-feeling blending sporty design cues, upscale features, and the kind of day-to-day dependability that helped make the Corolla one of the best-selling vehicles in automotive history.Under the hood sits Toyota s proven 1.8L Dual VVT-i 4-cylinder engine paired to a smooth CVT automatic transmission with Sport Drive Mode and steering wheel-mounted paddle shifters, giving this Corolla a more engaging personality than most expect from the segment. The XSE package adds an athletic stance with 17-inch machined alloy wheels, black painted accents, a rear spoiler, LED daytime running lights, and aggressive Multi-LED headlights that give the front end a far more upscale appearance than the average commuter sedan.Inside, the cabin feels exceptionally refined for a Corolla. Heated SofTex seats, an 8-way power adjustable driver seat, push-button start, Smart Key access, automatic climate control, and a power moonroof create an interior environment that punches above its class. Toyota s Entune Audio Plus system with touchscreen display, Bluetooth connectivity, SiriusXM capability, voice controls, and hands-free functionality keeps everything modern and user-friendly without becoming overly complicated.Safety was also a major focus for Toyota on this generation Corolla. Equipped with Toyota Safety Sense-P, this XSE includes Pre-Collision Warning with Pedestrian Detection, Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist, Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, and Automatic High Beams technology that many competitors reserved for far more expensive vehicles at the time. Combined with Toyota s Star Safety System and eight airbags, this Corolla was engineered to provide peace of mind as much as fuel efficiency.The 2019 Corolla XSE remains one of the smartest choices in today s used vehicle market because it successfully blends low ownership costs, impressive fuel economy, modern safety technology, and premium-level features into a sedan that still feels contemporary years later. Compared to many compact sedans in its class, the Corolla consistently stands out for long-term value retention, low maintenance costs, and an ownership experience that simply makes sense.Whether you are looking for a stylish daily commuter, a comfortable first vehicle, or a dependable sedan with upscale features without the luxury-brand price tag, this Corolla XSE checks an impressive number of boxes.Finance options are available for qualified buyers, and trade-ins are welcome. The 2023 Toyota Camry SE is a sophisticated and well-equipped midsize sedan that delivers a compelling blend of style, performance, and advanced technology. With its sleek exterior design, spacious and comfortable interior, and a robust suite of features, this Camry SE is the perfect choice for the discerning driver seeking a refined and capable daily companion.

Key highlights of this Camry SE include:

- All-Weather Floor Liners/Cargo Tray
- Cold Weather Package with Heated Steering Wheel, Heated Exterior Mirrors, and Multi-Stage Heated Front Seats
- Power Tilt/Slide Moonroof
- Qi-Compatible Wireless Smartphone Charging
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- Rear Bumper Applique
- Mudguards

The 2.5L I4 DOHC 16V engine, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, provides a responsive and efficient driving experience, delivering an impressive 25 city/34 highway MPG. This Camry SE is not only practical but also a joy to pilot, with its well-tuned suspension and precise steering delivering a confident and engaging ride.

Inside, the cabin is appointed with premium materials and thoughtful design elements, creating a refined and comfortable environment. The sport SofTex seat trim with fabric inserts adds a touch of sophistication, while the multi-stage heated front seats and heated steering wheel ensure your comfort, even on the coldest days.

The Camry SE also comes equipped with a host of advanced safety features, including the Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, Automatic High Beams, and the Smart Key System with Push-Button Start, providing you and your loved ones with added peace of mind on the road.

Whether you're commuting to the office, embarking on a road trip, or simply enjoying the daily drive, the 2023 Toyota Camry SE is the perfect companion.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. - Moonroof & Navigation & Heated Steering Wheel & Driver Focus

And with the intuitive Subaru STARLINK infotainment system, you'll enjoy seamless connectivity and a wealth of entertainment options at your fingertips.

Comfort and convenience are also hallmarks of this exceptional vehicle. The heated steering wheel and seats, along with the power moonroof, elevate every journey, while the spacious cabin and versatile cargo area ensure that you can accommodate all your lifestyle needs.

Experience the pinnacle of Subaru engineering and design in this 2023 Legacy Limited. Visit our showroom today to take this remarkable sedan for a test drive and discover how it can transform your driving experience.

description: Introducing the 2021 BMW 5 Series 530i xDrive, a masterpiece of German engineering that seamlessly blends performance, luxury, and cutting-edge technology. This exquisite sedan is designed for those who demand the best in every aspect of their driving experience. With 70,473 miles of adventure already under its belt, this BMW is ready to deliver countless more miles of driving pleasure. Draped in the sophisticated Bernina Grey Amber Effect Metallic Paint, this 5 Series exudes an aura of elegance and sophistication. The exterior is further enhanced by the Shadowline Package, which includes M shadowline lights and extended shadowline trim, giving the car a sleek and modern look that demands attention. The 20 in. M Y-Spoke Bi-Color Jet Black Wheels add a touch of sportiness and are paired with performance run-flat tires, ensuring that you are always ready for the road ahead. Step inside, and you'll be greeted by an interior that is nothing short of a sanctuary. The white Dakota Leather Upholstery offers a luxurious and comfortable environment, perfectly complemented by the Fine-Wood Open-Pored Ash Trunkwood Interior Trim with Pearl Chrome Accent. This combination of materials creates a cabin that is both inviting and sophisticated, making every journey a delight. Under the hood, the 2.0L Turbo I4 engine delivers a robust 248 horsepower and 257 lb-ft of torque, ensuring that you have all the power you need at your fingertips. Paired with an 8-Speed Shiftable Automatic w/Sport Transmission, this BMW offers a driving experience that is both exhilarating and smooth, whether you're navigating city streets or cruising on the highway. The 530i xDrive is not only about performance, it's packed with features designed to enhance your driving experience. The Premium Package includes remote engine start, a power tailgate, and heated front seats, ensuring comfort and convenience at every turn. The head-up display keeps you informed without taking your eyes off the road, while the harman/kardon surround sound system provides an immersive audio experience. Safety is paramount, and this BMW is equipped with the latest technology to keep you and your passengers secure. The Parking Assistance Package includes Parking Assistant Plus, active park distance control, a drive recorder, and a surround view with 3D view, making parking in any situation a breeze. Automatic emergency braking, a driver attention alert system, and a pre-collision warning system with audible warning add an extra layer of protection, giving you peace of mind on every journey. Stay connected with wireless Android Auto and enhanced USB and Bluetooth capabilities, ensuring that you can seamlessly integrate your smartphone with the vehicle's sophisticated navigation system. The heated steering wheel adds a touch of luxury, especially on those chilly mornings. This 2021 BMW 5 Series 530i xDrive has been recognized for its excellence, earning accolades from J.D. Power and Associates's Initial Quality Study (IQS) as a top model. While it is offered AS-IS with no warranty, you can drive with confidence knowing that this vehicle has been engineered to the highest standards. Don't miss your chance to own this exceptional vehicle. The 2021 BMW 5 Series 530i xDrive is more than just a car, it's a statement of style, performance, and luxury. Visit us today and experience the thrill of driving a BMW for yourself. Your dream car awaits!

Its compact enough for easy parking and city driving, yet substantial enough on the road to feel comfortable and stable during longer highway trips. The black-on-black color combination gives this sedan a sleek, timeless look that never really goes out of style. For anyone in the Pacific Northwest looking for a clean, comfortable, and dependable sedan with lower-than-average miles, this 2013 Volkswagen Jetta 2.0L S is an excellent opportunity to step into a vehicle that simply makes sense.

On the tech side, you re set up with Bluetooth wireless for hands-free calls, a navigation system to keep you on track, and an AM/FM stereo with CD/MP3 player and SiriusXM Satellite radio for all your music and entertainment needs. The electromechanical steering, tilt and telescoping wheel, and cruise control all make your drive smoother and more enjoyable. Outside, alloy wheels, daytime running lights, and fog lights help you stand out and see clearly in all conditions. Plus, according to the clean CARFAX report, this car has no reported accidents, so you can feel even more confident about your choice. All in all, this Audi A4 is ready to deliver a comfortable, safe, and enjoyable driving experience with the luxury touches you expect from Audi. description: Everyone wants to save money on gas and maintenance, which is one reason that Toyotas are so popular. For decades, the go to brand for inexpensive, reliable transportation has born the signature loopy T emblem of Toyota on the front, and people understand that in order to get something so fuel efficient and budget friendly you give up certain things like performance and style. Except nobody told Toyota. Most cars around this time came out looking like humps, lumps, and bugs, and Toyota kept the classy sedan lines from earlier generations while smoothing things out a little bit to add aerodynamic efficiency, making this one of the sportier looking compact sedans from the era. This car only has a 1.8L naturally aspirated four cylinder engine in it, but this thing has pep to it. Power even. When you want to go, it gets up and runs. Granted, the Toyota Corolla was one of the lightest vehicles in its class back in 2013, so the smaller engine didn't have as much to carry, but it still outperforms similarly sized vehicles with larger engines in my experience. On top of that, this car should still be getting about 34mpg on the highway and 26mpg in the city. The crash test rating is Good, and the Carfax is too with 26 service history records available. The gray color of both the interior and exterior is easy to keep clean and has aged exceptionally well for its age and miles. If you want something solid, dependable, and easy on the checking account to own, come drive this thing and see it's the right car for you! -Henry, The Car Son "Finding you the perfect ride, just like Dad would." -The Car Dad
